subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture deep-dive & scheduling
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anika Sharma <anika@carefirsthealth.com>, ops-eng@carefirsthealth.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Next steps: Private/VPC architecture deep-dive & scheduling

Hi Anika —

Thanks again for the discovery this morning (great to meet the CareFirst team). Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned before the architecture session:

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood Private (VPC) to host inference for PHI-bound workloads; target production in H1 2028.
- Success criteria you called out: <24ms p99 inference for chat endpoints, full audit logs + KMS integration, and tenant isolation across regions.
- Known constraints: existing on-prem VPN to AWS Direct Connect, prescriptive egress rules, and an internal security review expected mid-December.

Next step: we recommend a focused technical deep-dive with our infra engineers to walk network requirements, KMS/HSM options, and an initial runbook for POC. Can you confirm who from your infra/security teams will join?

Proposed 60-minute slots (all ET):
- Wed Nov 17 — 10:00–11:00
- Thu Nov 18 — 14:00–15:00
- Fri Nov 19 — 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, share two windows that suit you and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached our network-requirements.pdf and a short secure-architecture-checklist.xlsx to help prep. Please bring any existing network diagrams and the list of approved CIDR ranges so we can map them during the call.

Agenda (proposed):
1) 10m — quick objectives & success criteria
2) 25m — network / connectivity / firewall walkthrough
3) 15m — key integration points (KMS, logging, monitoring)
4) 10m — next steps & POC plan

Thanks — taking the lead on calendar coordination.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: network-requirements.pdf (pdf, 128KB), secure-architecture-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 46KB)

Thanks Mateo — this looks great.

We’d like to confirm Thu Nov 18 — 14:00–15:00 ET. I’m looping in our infra lead, Rajat Patel (rajat@carefirsthealth.com), who should be on the call to go through Direct Connect and firewall rules.

A couple of asks from our side before the deep-dive:
- Can you share a short list of the ports/protocols you expect for the POC?
- Any compliance artifacts we should have on hand for the security reviewers?

We’ll also share our current network diagram prior to the call.

Best,
Anika Sharma
